human_reorganization: The fixed-horizon finite-variation path-law obstruction is proved directly from exact kernel scaling and variation contraction. The named formal path-law result uses arbitrarily many fixed-step increments and increasing horizons; these are not conflated.

The signed quartic square cancellation is not an L2 norm limit: its actual absolute-variation error diverges. Normalized variation probabilities still have pointwise distance at least 24T from the proposed negative limit.

The explicit L2-small deterministic spike has constant fourth-power clock. Angular-frequency value exp(-1) corresponds to the formal 2pi-frequency convention after rescaling; no continuity claim on the stronger factorial domain is refuted.

The final complementary-derivative channel is necessary for the displayed terminal test by a direct derivative calculation. The named source proves first-channel range failure; no general channel minimality or synthesis injectivity is inferred.

Section 3 gives the elementary factorial-series reconstruction of the faithful one-coordinate realization. Every derivative at zero is an ell1 coefficient. Actual integer-order arithmetic theta moments have the lower bound d*4^n from the fixed positive interval [2,3], so they cannot be realized in this coefficient domain. The actual real/complex derivative bridge and nonmembership theorem are mapped. This does not assert nonrepresentability in every multivariate quotient, injectivity of the completed product pairing, a failure of the scoped signed reconstruction, or a zero/threshold/RH implication. The coefficient-growth test is elementary and is not claimed novel.

Section 3 reconstructs the finite Appell algebra using explicitly formal coefficient generating functions, not an unproved integral of an exponential series. Leading pairings expose full polynomial nondegeneracy, uniqueness of x/(pa) as the higher-order polynomial Stein weight, and failure of a polynomial representative for coordinate one or first derivative when p>2. The Gaussian p=2 case is retained as an exception.

Actual derivatives of the real Schwartz heat kernel divided by factorials give absolutely polynomial-integrable Lebesgue density duals. No L2 score or bounded completed coordinate map is inferred. The impossibility of rho_1=W*k for polynomial W is a labelled elementary consequence of the mapped first-order obstruction.

The unique centered polynomial primitive and all finite derivative-primitive tails are reconstructed on the monic basis. Removing all low Appell coordinates is distinct from centering; x^(p+1) supplies a nonzero coordinate-one witness. These static identities are not asserted to define chronological stochastic integration or replace the native multitime convergence proof.

Hile–Stanoyevitch primary Sections 3–4 establish broader classical polynomial evolution/generating-function antecedents. Exact polynomial-coordinate obstruction priority remains unresolved; no new Appell mechanism is claimed.

Section 12.5 realizes normalized-time terminal cylinders on actual zero-start continuous real paths. The physical terminal moments are at horizon T. The normalized polynomial sequence converges uniformly on every compact subset of path space but its signed means remain exactly one, proving no closed partial-operator extension in that input topology.

The compact-open obstruction also holds at p=2 for the positive Gaussian heat law with variance 2T, so it is expressly not presented as a probability-law obstruction. It does not concern uniformly bounded tests or convergence in the stronger factorial analytic norm.

Section 12.6 uses the actual nonzero odd Schwartz function x exp(-x^2) against all even zero-start heat marginals. All starts at one fixed positive time do separate by nonvanishing Fourier multiplier. Angular frequency is kept consistent with the paper, while source multiplier formulas use unit frequency 2pi. No bounded inverse or completed-pairing injectivity claim follows.
